description: Chinese small low-profit enterprise corporate income tax: 25% of taxable income at 20% (5% effective) until 2027-12-31 when taxable income <= 3 million CNY, employees <= 300, assets <= 50 million CNY and the industry is not restricted (MOF/STA 2023 No. 12); otherwise 25%. Mainland China, as of 2026-11-21 (laws and State Taxation Administration announcements in the official regulations database). General information and estimates only; no individual tax consulting, agency or filing. The 2027 filing calendar is not yet published.
